import json,hashlib,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
import physical_c_bare_electric_auxiliary_continuum as c
started=time.time()
with c.mp.workdps(45):case=c.run_order(5,{},c.normalized_background())
inputs=json.dumps(dict(API='run_order',order=5,kappa='.01',beta=100,Utheta='.02',Gaussian_width=3.5,dps=45,unit_L2_mode=True),sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
v=dict(case=case,execution=dict(source_at_IMPORT=hashlib.sha256(c.SOURCE_BYTES).hexdigest(),source_bytes_at_IMPORT=c.SOURCE_BYTES.decode(),bundle_at_IMPORT=hashlib.sha256(c.BUNDLE_BYTES).hexdigest(),bundle_bytes_at_IMPORT=c.BUNDLE_BYTES.decode(),loop_at_IMPORT=hashlib.sha256(c.bundle.LOOP_BYTES).hexdigest(),loop_bytes_at_IMPORT=c.bundle.LOOP_BYTES.decode(),exact_fast_AST=c.T4_AST,input_json=inputs,input_sha256=hashlib.sha256(inputs.encode()).hexdigest(),runtime_seconds=time.time()-started,executable=sys.executable,python=sys.version,startup_unchanged=Path(c.__file__).read_bytes()==c.SOURCE_BYTES and Path(c.bundle.__file__).read_bytes()==c.BUNDLE_BYTES and Path(c.loops.__file__).read_bytes()==c.bundle.LOOP_BYTES))
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(source=v['execution']['source_at_IMPORT'],wholehalf=case['actual_WHOLEhalf_RAW_creator'],original=case['original_FIXED_meanbody_normalized_FULL_K_output_Gram_interval'])))
